Campus Accessibility Project Statistics: • This project, would provide dedicated resources to improve campus access to persons with disabilities. Projects include restroom improvements, exterior pedestrian improvements, and discrete building improvements such as elevator modernizations. URI has 80 elevators. Of these, 19 are more than 30 years old and only 18 are newer than 10 years. Many of our buildings are served by single units. The combination of single units and aged equipment often results in downtime and limits access.
